title: Reciprocal Sqrt
text: Calculate square root, signed square root, or reciprocal of square root, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Output signal type} sets Output signal type; {Function}, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {Method}, {Number of iterations}, {Intermediate results data type} sets the data type of intermediate results, {Output}, {Minimum}, {Maximum}, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data and {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Function
params.values: Function the block performs sqrt | signedSqrt | rSqrt

params.name: Output signal type
params.values: Output signal type auto (default) | real | complex

params.name: Method
params.values: Method to compute reciprocal of square root Exact (default) | Newton-Raphson

params.name: Number of iterations
params.values: Number of iterations used for Newton Raphson algorithm 3 (default) | integer

params.name: Intermediate results data type
params.values: Data type of intermediate results Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Inherit from input | Inherit: Inherit from output | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) |

params.name: Output
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Same as first input (default) | Inherit: Inherit via internal rule | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | double | single | half | int8 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) | |...

params.name: Minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action on (default) | off
